This paper addresses this gap by investigating whether LLMs develop neuron-level functional specialization, analogous to cortical localization in the human brain , when exposed to tasks that elicit either memorization or generalization.
datasets: Synthetic induction-style dataset adapted from bAbI
Synthetic arithmetic addition dataset with memorization patterns
outputs: Generated answers (e.g., colors, sums, pattern tokens)

The model outputs include answers to in-context inference questions (e.g., 'What color is Vicky?'), arithmetic sums, and plaintext decoding of ciphertext, with behaviors categorized as memorization or generalization.
